sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Paddle moved only 1 UP (16->12) despite 3 UPs. Maybe blocked at row 12? Test UP once more + DOWN range.
def snap():
    out={}
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','c','M'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return out
print('now', snap())
r = action(['UP'])
print('after UP', snap(), r['state'])
r = action(['UP'])
print('after UP2', snap(), r['state'])
# now test DOWN range
for i in range(8):
    r = action(['DOWN'])
    s = snap()
    print('DOWN', i, s.get('b'), r['state'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
